# ReplyFlow — Full Site Index

> ReplyFlow is an AI sales automation agency that builds done-for-you AI lead follow-up systems. We respond to every inbound lead in under 90 seconds, run 7-touch automated follow-up sequences across email, SMS and voice, reactivate cold/dead lead databases, and book qualified calls straight onto your calendar — 24/7, without you hiring a single sales rep.

ReplyFlow is a ProfessionalService (schema.org) business focused on AI Sales Automation, Lead Follow-Up Systems, Sales Development, Lead Nurture Automation, and Cold Lead Reactivation. The founding team is led by Nleanya Treasure (Founder & Visionary) and Marcus Vector (Creative Director).

## What ReplyFlow Does

- **AI Lead Follow-Up:** Every inbound lead gets an instant, personalised reply within 90 seconds, 24/7 including weekends and holidays.
- **7-Touch Automated Sequences:** Multi-step follow-up across email, SMS, and voice runs on autopilot.
- **Dead Lead Reactivation:** Re-engage cold leads from your CRM with AI-powered campaigns that achieve 8–15% re-engagement rates.
- **AI Appointment Setting:** Qualify leads and book discovery calls automatically — no human SDR required.
- **AI SDR Systems:** Replace or augment your sales development team with always-on AI.
- **Cold Email Automation:** AI-crafted, deliverability-optimised cold outreach sequences.
- **Speed to Lead:** Respond before competitors even open their laptop.

## Who ReplyFlow Helps

- Marketing and digital agencies that need a steady pipeline of new clients
- B2B service businesses with long sales cycles and slow follow-up

## Why Businesses Choose ReplyFlow

- Studies show 78% of deals go to the first company to respond; the average business takes 47 hours to follow up.
- ReplyFlow eliminates that gap entirely — leads hear back in 90 seconds, not 2 days.
- Clients typically see 2–3x more booked calls and 30–50% more closed revenue from their existing lead flow.
- No hiring, no management overhead. Strategy, build, integration, copywriting, testing, and ongoing optimisation are all handled.
- Most clients are live in 72 hours.

## FAQ

- **What is an AI SDR?** An AI SDR (AI Sales Development Representative) is an AI system that handles outbound prospecting, inbound lead response, follow-up sequences, and qualification conversations — replacing or augmenting human SDRs.
- **How fast does ReplyFlow respond to leads?** Within 90 seconds, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week — including weekends and holidays.
- **Can AI replace my sales team?** AI handles the top of funnel — instant response, qualification, nurture, and call booking. Human closers handle discovery calls and proposals. The best results come from combining both.
- **What is dead lead reactivation?** Re-engaging cold leads from your database who previously showed interest but went quiet. AI reactivation campaigns typically achieve 8–15% re-engagement rates.
